title: Design: A/P Location chip and menu match Sales By Customer's
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location menu lists two locations ("2 selected").
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
  • Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the Location chip and compare with Sales By Customer's.
  2. Click it and read the menu, row by row, letter for letter.
  3. Compare the open menu with Sales By Customer's open Location menu.
  4. Switch ShopView to dark theme.
  5. Click the Location chip again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Label "Location" with the location pin icon, the same chip as Sales By Customer's.

Step 2:

  • In this order: "Select all", the count ("2 selected"), the locations with the ticked ones first, and "Clear selection".
  • No search box (fewer than 9 locations).

Step 3:

  • The same menu: same rows, order, tick boxes, spacing and position under the chip.

Step 4:

  • The page switches to dark theme.

Step 5:

  • The menu opens: the same, readable in dark theme, nothing clipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R2: “The Location chip and its open menu are the native ones, exactly as on Sales By Customer, Inventory Value and Work In Progress: label "Location" with the location pin icon; the menu shows a "Select all" row, a "{N} selected" count, the locations with the ticked ones first, a search box with the placeholder "Search locations" once there are more than 8 locations, and "Clear selection".”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”
